name: Cloak of the Bat
description: A dark leather cloak whose hem is cut like a bat's wings.
body:
## What it does

In its folds you slip from sight easily. In dim light or darkness you can hold its edges and fly, and once a day, in the dark, you can turn yourself into a bat.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.note: on yourself only, into a bat, in dim light or darkness

features.name: Night Wings
features.text: You fly only in dim light or darkness, holding the cloak's edges with both hands.
